description: JavaScript module defining functions and objects for handling external OAuth provider fields in SuiteCRM, including getters, setters, and UI manipulation methods.

methods.name: getDefaultFieldGetter
methods.description: Returns a function to get the value of a field, defaulting to jQuery val()

methods.name: getFunctionFieldGetter
methods.description: Returns a function to get text content from a DOM element

methods.name: getDefaultFieldSetter
methods.description: Returns a function to set the value of a field and trigger change

methods.name: getFunctionFieldSetter
methods.description: Returns a function to set innerText of a DOM element

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a specified field using appropriate setter

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified field using appropriate getter

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the UI element associated with a field

methods.name: show
methods.description: Shows the UI element associated with a field

methods.name: getField$
methods.description: Retrieves the jQuery object for a field input element

methods.name: getFieldCell$
methods.description: Retrieves the jQuery object for a field's container element

methods.name: getFieldType
methods.description: Returns the data type of a field

methods.name: getValueGetter
methods.description: Returns the appropriate getter function based on field type

methods.name: getValueSetter
methods.description: Returns the appropriate setter function based on field type
